root_cause: Two different kinds of wasm function indices exist in V8's codebase: the 'declared function index' (excludes imported functions) and the 'module function index' (includes imported functions). NativeModule::GetCode() expects the latter and performs its own conversion via declared_function_index(). The introducing commit passed the already-declared index directly to GetCode() without converting it back to a module-scoped index, causing the conversion to be applied twice.
findings: In Runtime_WasmLiftoffDeoptFinish, when v8_flags.trace_deopt_verbose is enabled and a feedback vector needs to be allocated, the code calls trusted_instance_data->native_module()->GetCode(declared_func_index).
